description: Hand-curated module taxonomy for Product Map classification. Customize per your product. Replace examples below with your actual modules.

auth.name: Authentication & Session
auth.description: Login, 2FA, password reset, sessions, tokens. Universal across products.

{your-module-1}.name: {Your Module Name}
{your-module-1}.description: Replace with description of this product area.

infra.name: Infrastructure & Performance
infra.description: Performance, deploy, environments, schema drift. Useful for most products.

misc.name: Miscellaneous / Cross-cutting
misc.description: Catch-all for entries that span multiple modules or don't fit cleanly. Aim for <30% of entries here — if higher, taxonomy needs more keywords.

ambiguity_rules.description: Example: when X table is referenced in auth context → auth module, in business context → business module

_setup_notes: 1. Replace {your-module-N} with actual product modules (e.g. for SaaS: 'subscriptions', 'billing', 'integrations')
2. Add 6-12 modules total. Too few = misc bucket overflows. Too many = classification ambiguity.
3. Each module needs 5-15 keywords + synonyms for reliable scoring.
4. Run scripts/refresh-product-map.py and check unclassified rate. <10% = good, >30% = expand keywords.
5. Iterate — taxonomy is living document, evolves as product evolves.
6. See knowledge_base/_module_taxonomy.json (in source ScaleFinal repo) for working example with 12 modules.
